services.name: Sunrise Hot Air Balloon Ride Orlando
Sunrise Balloon Flight
services.desc: 3 hours total, 1 hour flight. About We usually fly from the treetops to 1000 feet. At treetop level we frequently spot deer and other wildlife, and also talk to people down below. It's always interesting to see them look around for the voices from above. At 1000 feet we get a great view of the Disney, Epcot, Kissimmee, and Orlando skylines, as well as the many lakes in the Bob Recommends Ages 5+ • 3 Hours • 1 hour before sunrise

blurb: Guests take a sunrise hot air balloon ride guided by an expert pilot, flying over areas including Kissimmee, Disney World, and Davenport. The flight offers panoramic views of lakes, wildlife, skylines, and city attractions. It is suitable for special occasions like birthdays, engagements, anniversaries, or corporate outings.

extraNote: If we have to cancel due to weather you will receive a refund in full. · To allow us time to book replacement passengers, we require 48 hours notice to cancel a booked trip. · Gift card sales are final and non-refundable. · We fly 365 days a year in Central Florida, weather permitting. · There is a negligible temperature difference from the ground at our altitudes, so dress comfortably for the temperature of the day. Skirts may not be suitable for some of our landing spots. Sneakers, comfortable flat shoes, or hiking boots are the preferred footwear. Also be sure to bring cameras, camcorders, sun glasses, and a hat if you wish.
